>         {
>             annotation { "Name" : "Outer wall thickness" }
>             isLength(definition.wallThickness, { (meter) : [0.001, 0.007, 0.05], (millimeter) : 7 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Inner frame thickness" }
>             isLength(definition.frameThickness, { (meter) : [0.001, 0.018, 0.1], (millimeter) : 18 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Beam and post width" }
>             isLength(definition.memberWidth, { (meter) : [0.01, 0.06, 0.3], (millimeter) : 60 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Inside corner radius" }
>             isLength(definition.insideRadius, { (meter) : [0.001, 0.025, 0.2], (millimeter) : 25 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Slat thickness", "Description" : "Timber slat thickness; top remains at platform height." }
>             isLength(definition.slatThickness, { (meter) : [0.001, 0.018, 0.1], (millimeter) : 18 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>         }
>         annotation { "Group Name" : "Long bench sliding slats", "Collapsed By Default" : false }
>         {
>             annotation { "Name" : "Show slats", "Default" : true,
>                 "Description" : "Show fixed and moving slats on both benches, the cross-bench lid and plate stops. Turn off to see the support frames, guides and drawer." }
>             definition.showSlats is boolean;
>             annotation { "Name" : "Slat width" }
>             isLength(definition.slatWidth, { (meter) : [0.01,0.08,0.3], (millimeter) : 80 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Clearance each side of moving slat",
>                 "Description" : "Fixed-slat clear gap = slat width + twice this clearance (90 mm at baseline)." }
>             isLength(definition.slatSideGap, { (meter) : [0.0001,0.005,0.03], (millimeter) : 5 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Flat inner strip width", "Description" : "Thickness follows inner frame plywood; stops against fixed aisle frame when extended." }
>             isLength(definition.slidingStripWidth, { (meter) : [0.005,0.04,0.2], (millimeter) : 40 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Guide ledge width", "Description" : "18 mm plywood at baseline. Rear ledge inset to clear the rear corner." }
>             isLength(definition.ledgeWidth, { (meter) : [0.005,0.025,0.1], (millimeter) : 25 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Strip end clearance" }
>             isLength(definition.stripEndClearance, { (meter) : [0.0001,0.002,0.02], (millimeter) : 2 } as LengthBoundSpec);
>         }
>         annotation { "Group Name" : "Cross bench sliding slats", "Collapsed By Default" : false }
>         {
>             annotation { "Name" : "Fixed deck thickness" }
>             isLength(definition.crossDeckThickness, { (millimeter):[7,12,30] } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Toilet bay extra depth",
>                 "Description" : "Added to assumed toilet depth along the pull-out direction. Baseline 20 mm total; slide tray fit remains unresolved." }
>             isLength(definition.toiletBayAllowance, { (millimeter):[0,20,100] } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Storage lid clearance gap" }
>             isLength(definition.storageLidGap, { (millimeter):[0.5,2,5] } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Storage lid finger hole diameter" }
>             isLength(definition.storageLidFingerDiameter, { (millimeter):[15,25,40] } as LengthBoundSpec);
>         }
>         annotation { "Group Name" : "Cross bench recessed plate stops", "Collapsed By Default" : true }
>         {
>             annotation { "Name" : "Plate length across slats" }
>             isLength(definition.stopPlateLength, { (millimeter):[30,100,150] } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Plate width along slide travel" }
>             isLength(definition.stopPlateWidth, { (millimeter):[10,22,50] } as LengthBoundSpec);
>             annotation { "Name" : "Plate thickness - provisional" }

> ```text
> ## transform
>
>
> [Transform](#Transform)
> type
>
>
> A `Transform` typically represents a change of position and orientation in 3D space (other affine transformations, such as scaling and shearing, can also be represented).
>
>
> [`rotationAround`](#rotationAround-Line-ValueWithUnits), [`scaleUniformly`](#scaleUniformly-number), [`transform(Vector)`](#transform-Vector), [`toWorld(CoordSystem)`](#toWorld-CoordSystem) and [`fromWorld(CoordSystem)`](#fromWorld-CoordSystem) return useful transforms. `Transform`s are commonly used with [`opTransform`](#opTransform-Context-Id-map), whose documentation has examples of calling these functions.
>
>
> `Transform`s are also commonly used with their `*` operator overloads to easily work with geometry in multiple coordinate systems.
>
>
> EXAMPLE
>
>
> > `transform * (vector(1, 1, 1) * inch)` yields a point which is the given point, transformed by the `transform`.
>
>
> EXAMPLE
>
>
> > `transform2 * transform1` yields a new transform which is equivalent to applying `transform1` followed by `transform2`.
>
>
> A `Transform` contains a linear portion (rotation, scaling, or shearing), which is applied first, and a translation vector, which is applied second. Generally, these individual fields on this type don't need to be directly used, and everything you need can be accomplished through the operator overloads above, or other functions in this module and the `coordSystem` module.
>
>
> | `Transform`   | `map`    |                                                                                                    |
> | ------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | `linear`      | `Matrix` | A linear motion, which is generally a rotation, but can also be a scaling, inversion, or shearing. |
> | `translation` | `Vector` | A 3D translation vector.                                                                           |
>
>
> [canBeTransform](#canBeTransform-)
> (value)
> predicate
>
>
> Typecheck for [`Transform`](#Transform)
>
>
> [transform](#transform-Matrix-Vector)
> (linear is [Matrix](#Matrix), translation is [Vector](#Vector))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Construct a [`Transform`](#Transform) using the matrix argument for rotation and scaling and the vector argument for translation.
>
>
> [transform](#transform-Vector)
> (translation is [Vector](#Vector))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Construct a [`Transform`](#Transform) that translates without rotation or scaling.
>
>
> [transform](#transform-map)
> (value is [map](/FsDoc/variables.html#map))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> [identityTransform](#identityTransform)
> ()
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Construct a transform that does nothing (no rotation, scaling, or translation).
>
>
> [tolerantEquals](#tolerantEquals-Transform-Transform)
> (transform1 is [Transform](#Transform), transform2 is [Transform](#Transform))
> predicate
>
>
> Check that two [`Transform`](#Transform)s are the same up to tolerance.
>
>
> [inverse](#inverse-Transform)
> (t is [Transform](#Transform))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Compute the inverse of a [`Transform`](#Transform), such that `inverse(t) * t == identityTransform()`.
>
>
> [scaleUniformly](#scaleUniformly-number)
> (scale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Returns a [`Transform`](#Transform) that represents a uniform scaling around the origin.
>
>
> [scaleUniformly](#scaleUniformly-number-Vector)
> (scale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number), pointToScaleAbout is [Vector](#Vector))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Returns a [`Transform`](#Transform) that represents a uniform scaling around `pointToScaleAbout`.
>
>
> [scaleNonuniformly](#scaleNonuniformly-number-number-number)
> (xScale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number), yScale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number), zScale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Returns a [`Transform`](#Transform) that represents 3 independent scalings along the X, Y, and Z axes, centered around the origin.
>
>
> [scaleNonuniformly](#scaleNonuniformly-number-number-number-Vector)
> (xScale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number), yScale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number), zScale is [number](/FsDoc/variables.html#number), pointToScaleAbout is [Vector](#Vector))
>  returns [Transform](#Transform)
>
>
> Returns a [`Transform`](#Transform) that represents 3 independent scalings along the X, Y, and Z axes, centered around `pointToScaleAbout`.

> ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | `definition` | `map`       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
> | `bodies`     | `Query`     | The bodies to transform.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
> | `transform`  | `Transform` | The transform to apply.  EXAMPLE `transform(vector(0, 0, 1) * inch)` will translate the body 1 inch along the world's z-axis. EXAMPLE `rotationAround(myLine, 30 * degree)` will rotate around a `Line` object. EXAMPLE `scaleUniformly(factor)` will scale uniformly about the origin. EXAMPLE `scaleUniformly(factor, point)` will scale uniformly about a given point. EXAMPLE `toWorld(cSys)` will (somewhat counterintuitively) perform a transform such that geometry on the world's origin and axes will move to the `cSys` origin and axes. EXAMPLE `fromWorld(cSys)` will (somewhat counterintuitively) perform a transform such that geometry on the `cSys` origin and axes will move to the world origin and axes. EXAMPLE `transform2 * transform1` will perform `transform1`, followed by `transform2`. |
>
>
> [opWrap](#opWrap-Context-Id-map)
> (context is [Context](#Context), id is [Id](#Id), definition is [map](/FsDoc/variables.html#map))
>
>
> Wraps or unwraps faces from one surface onto another. The location and orientation of the wrapped faces on the destination surface are controlled by the `anchorPoint` and `anchorDirection` of the `source` and `destination` [`WrapSurface`](#WrapSurface)s. The `entities` of the operation are not affected, the result of this operation is a new set of surface bodies or imprinted edges representing the wrapped or unwrapped faces. Faces that are topologically connected will remain topologically connected in the result body for `WrapType.SIMPLE` and `WrapType.TRIM`. This operation currently supports wrapping from a plane onto a cylinder or a cone, and unwrapping from a cylinder or a cone onto a plane.
>
>
> (Formerly `opRoll`)
>
>
> | Parameter               | Type          | Additional Info                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
> | ----------------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | `definition`            | `map`         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
> | `wrapType`              | `WrapType`    | The type of wrap to execute.  EXAMPLE `WrapType.SIMPLE` wraps `entities` around the infinite definition of `destination`.
> ```

>         "cabinetDepth" : d.cargoWidth - d.bedWidth,
>         "aisleWidth" : d.bedWidth - d.longBenchWidth - d.frameThickness,
>         "innerGap" : d.seatLength - d.cabinetOuterLength,
>         "outerGap" : d.seatLength - d.cabinetOuterLength,
>         "frontUnbacked" : max(d.bedWidth - infillWidth - d.foamThickness - d.cabBackrestLength, 0*millimeter),
>         "cabBackrestOverhang" : max(d.foamThickness + d.cabBackrestLength - (d.bedWidth-infillWidth), 0*millimeter),
>         "rearBackrestOverhang" : max(d.foamThickness + d.seatLength - d.cabBackrestLength - d.longBenchWidth, 0*millimeter)
>     };
>     if (p.baseHeight <= 0 * centimeter)
>         throw regenError("Platform height must be positive.", ["platformHeight"]);
>     if (d.bedWidth <= d.longBenchWidth || d.cargoWidth <= d.bedWidth)
>         throw regenError("Require cargo width > bed width > long bench width.",
>             ["cargoWidth", "bedWidth", "longBenchWidth"]);
>     if (d.foamThickness >= d.longBenchWidth || d.foamThickness >= p.crossSeatWidth ||
>         d.foamThickness >= p.dLength || d.foamThickness >= d.seatLength)
>         throw regenError("Upright backrests must leave room on both seat cushions.",
>             ["foamThickness","longBenchWidth","bedWidth","seatLength","cargoLength"]);
>     if (d.cabBackrestLength <= 0*millimeter || p.rearBackrestLength <= 0*millimeter)
>         throw regenError("Cab-facing backrest length must be positive and shorter than the long bench length.",
>             ["cabBackrestLength","seatLength"]);
>     if (d.seatLength <= 0 * millimeter || p.dLength <= 0 * millimeter)
>         throw regenError("Long bench length must be positive and remain shorter than the cargo length.",
>             ["seatLength", "cargoLength"]);
>     if (p.outerGap < 0 * centimeter)
>         throw regenError("Cabinet length must not exceed the long bench length.",
>             ["cabinetOuterLength", "seatLength"]);
>     return p;
> }
>
>
> function nameAndColor(context is Context, bodies is Query, name is string, appearance is Color)
> {
>     setProperty(context, { "entities" : bodies, "propertyType" : PropertyType.NAME, "value" : name });
>     setProperty(context, { "entities" : bodies, "propertyType" : PropertyType.APPEARANCE, "value" : appearance });
> }
>
> function makeBlock(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, lo is Vector, hi is Vector, appearance is Color)
> {
>     fCuboid(context, id, { "corner1" : lo, "corner2" : hi });
>     nameAndColor(context, qCreatedBy(id, EntityType.BODY), name, appearance);
> }
>
> function footprintSketch(context is Context, id is Id, points is array)
> {
>     const sketch = newSketchOnPlane(context, id, {
>         "sketchPlane" : plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * centimeter, vector(0, 0, 1), vector(1, 0, 0))
>     });
>     skPolyline(sketch, "outline", { "points" : points });
>     skSolve(sketch);
> }
>
> /** Rounded opening cutter in the vertical plane of a plywood panel. */
> function openingTool(context is Context, id is Id, origin is Vector, along is Vector,
>     normal is Vector, x0, x1, bottom, top, radius, depth)
> {
>     const sketch = newSketchOnPlane(context, id + "sketch", {
>         "sketchPlane" : plane(origin, normal, along)
>     });
>     const r = radius;
>     const k = 1 - 1 / sqrt(2);
>     skLineSegment(sketch, "bottom", { "start" : vector(x0+r,bottom), "end" : vector(x1-r,bottom) });
>     skArc(sketch, "br", { "start" : vector(x1-r,bottom),
>         "mid" : vector(x1-k*r,bottom+k*r), "end" : vector(x1,bottom+r) });
>     skLineSegment(sketch, "right", { "start" : vector(x1,bottom+r), "end" : vector(x1,top-r) });
>     skArc(sketch, "tr", { "start" : vector(x1,top-r),
>         "mid" : vector(x1-k*r,top-k*r), "end" : vector(x1-r,top) });
>     skLineSegment(sketch, "top", { "start" : vector(x1-r,top), "end" : vector(x0+r,top) });
>     skArc(sketch, "tl", { "start" : vector(x0+r,top),
>         "mid" : vector(x0+k*r,top-k*r), "end" : vector(x0,top-r) });
>     skLineSegment(sketch, "left", { "start" : vector(x0,top-r), "end" : vector(x0,bottom+r) });
>     skArc(sketch, "bl", { "start" : vector(x0,bottom+r),
>         "mid" : vector(x0+k*r,bottom+k*r), "end" : vector(x0+r,bottom) });
>     skSolve(sketch);
>     opExtrude(context, id + "solid", { "entities" : qSketchRegion(id + "sketch"),
>         "direction" : normal, "endBound" : BoundingType.BLIND, "endDepth" : depth });
>     opDeleteBodies(context, id + "cleanup", { "entities" : qCreatedBy(id + "sketch", EntityType.BODY) });
> }
>
> /** Access faces use an open-bottom frame only; closed faces also retain a solid outer skin. */
> function benchWall(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, origin is Vector,
>     along is Vector, normal is Vector, length, height, bays is number, access is boolean, d is map, parameterIds is array)
> {
>     const w = d.memberWidth;
>     const r = d.insideRadius;
>     const bay = (length - (bays + 1) * w) / bays;
>     if (bay <= 2*r || height <= 2*w + 2*r)
>         throw regenError("Panel is too small for its bands, posts and corner radii.",
>             parameterIds);
>     const up = vector(0,0,1);
>     for (var layer = access ? 1 : 0; layer < 2; layer += 1)
>     {
>         const layerId = id + ("layer" ~ layer);
>         const offset = layer == 0 || access ? 0*millimeter : d.wallThickness;
>         const thickness = layer == 0 ? d.wallThickness : d.frameThickness;
>         const start = origin + normal*offset;
>         fCuboid(context, layerId + "plate", {
>             "corner1" : start,
>             "corner2" : start + along*length + normal*thickness + up*height
>         });
>         const plate = qCreatedBy(layerId + "plate", EntityType.BODY);
>         if (layer == 1)
>         {
>             for (var i = 0; i < bays; i += 1)
>             {
>                 const cutId = layerId + ("opening" ~ i);
>                 const left = w + i*(bay+w);
>                 // All frame openings reach the floor; no cut-out outer skins are generated.
>                 const bottom = -2*r;
>                 openingTool(context, cutId, start - normal*millimeter, along, normal,
>                     left, left+bay, bottom, height-w, r, thickness+2*millimeter);
>                 opBoolean(context, cutId + "subtract", {
>                     "tools" : qCreatedBy(cutId + "solid", EntityType.BODY),
>                     "targets" : plate, "operationType" : BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION
>                 });
>             }
>         }
>         nameAndColor(context, plate, name ~ (layer == 0 ? " - outer wall" : " - inner frame"),
>             layer == 0 ? color(0.75,0.66,0.49) : color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
>     }
> }
>
>
>
>
> /** Door reference outlines only; rectangles do not imply body contours, door leaves or travel paths. */
> function doorOutline(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, origin is Vector,
>     normal is Vector, along is Vector, width, height)
> {
>     const zero = 0*millimeter;
>     const sketch = newSketchOnPlane(context,id,{"sketchPlane":plane(origin,normal,along)});
>     const corners = [vector(zero,zero),vector(width,zero),vector(width,height),vector(zero,height)];
>     for (var i = 0; i < 4; i += 1)
>         skLineSegment(sketch,"edge" ~ i,{"start":corners[i],"end":corners[(i+1)%4],"construction":true});
>     skSolve(sketch);
>     setProperty(context,{"entities":qCreatedBy(id,EntityType.BODY),"propertyType":PropertyType.NAME,"value":name});
> }
>
> /** Rounded upper ends only: editable visual approximation, with the full base footprint retained. */
> function wheelArchReference(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, x, depth, d is map)
> {
>     const r = d.archRadius;
>     const length = d.archLength;
>     const height = d.archHeight;
>     if (r <= 0*millimeter || 2*r >= length || r >= height)
>         throw regenError("Arch rounding radius must be positive, below its height and below half its length.",
>             ["archRadius", "archLength", "archHeight"]);
>     const zero = 0*millimeter;
>     const k = 1-1/sqrt(2);
>     const sketch = newSketchOnPlane(context,id+"profile",{
>         "sketchPlane":plane(vector(x,d.archRearOffset,zero),vector(1,0,0),vector(0,1,0))
>     });
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"base",{"start":vector(zero,zero),"end":vector(length,zero)});
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"front",{"start":vector(length,zero),"end":vector(length,height-r)});
>     skArc(sketch,"frontRound",{"start":vector(length,height-r),
>         "mid":vector(length-k*r,height-k*r),"end":vector(length-r,height)});
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"top",{"start":vector(length-r,height),"end":vector(r,height)});
>     skArc(sketch,"rearRound",{"start":vector(r,height),
>         "mid":vector(k*r,height-k*r),"end":vector(zero,height-r)});
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"rear",{"start":vector(zero,height-r),"end":vector(zero,zero)});
>     skSolve(sketch);
>     opExtrude(context,id+"body",{"entities":qSketchRegion(id+"profile"),"direction":vector(1,0,0),
>         "endBound":BoundingType.BLIND,"endDepth":depth});
>     opDeleteBodies(context,id+"cleanup",{"entities":qCreatedBy(id+"profile",EntityType.BODY)});
>     nameAndColor(context,qCreatedBy(id+"body",EntityType.BODY),name,color(0.45,0.49,0.52));
> }
>
>
> /** Concave rear body corner surface. Radius is provisional; height follows the rear opening reference. */
> function rearCornerReference(context is Context, id is Id, right is boolean, d is map)
> {
>     const r = d.rearCornerRadius;
>     const k = 1-1/sqrt(2);
>     const zero = 0*millimeter;
>     const x = right ? d.cargoWidth : zero;
>     const sign = right ? -1 : 1;
>     const sketch = newSketchOnPlane(context,id+"profile",{
>         "sketchPlane":plane(vector(zero,zero,zero),vector(0,0,1),vector(1,0,0))
>     });
>     skArc(sketch,"corner",{"start":vector(x+sign*r,zero),
>         "mid":vector(x+sign*k*r,k*r),"end":vector(x,r)});
>     skSolve(sketch);
>     opExtrude(context,id+"surface",{"entities":qCreatedBy(id+"profile",EntityType.EDGE),
>         "direction":vector(0,0,1),"endBound":BoundingType.BLIND,
>         "endDepth":d.rearDoorSill+d.rearDoorHeight});
>     opDeleteBodies(context,id+"cleanup",{"entities":qCreatedBy(id+"profile",EntityType.BODY)});
>     nameAndColor(context,qCreatedBy(id+"surface",EntityType.BODY),
>         (right ? "Right" : "Left") ~ " rear body corner - approximate surface",color(0.55,0.58,0.61));
> }
>
> /** Frame only along the long bench wall: broad rear end, one post after the arch, front end. */
> function wheelArchFrame(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, variablePrefix is string,
>     frameX, y, length, height, combineFrontPosts is boolean, d is map)
> {
>     const w = d.memberWidth;
>     const parameterIds = variablePrefix == "nv200_cabinet" ?
>         ["cabinetHeight", "cabinetOuterLength", "memberWidth", "insideRadius",
>          "archRearOffset", "archLength", "archHeight", "archClearance", "rearCornerRadius", "rearCornerAllowance"] :
>         ["platformHeight", "slatThickness", "seatLength", "memberWidth", "insideRadius",
>          "archRearOffset", "archLength", "archHeight", "archClearance", "rearCornerRadius", "rearCornerAllowance"];
>     const setback = d.rearCornerRadius+d.rearCornerAllowance;
>     const rearSupportEnd = max(d.archRearOffset-d.archClearance,setback+w);
>     const rearClearance = d.archRearOffset-rearSupportEnd;
>     if (rearClearance <= 0*millimeter)
>         throw regenError("Rear corner setback and post reach the wheel arch. Check measured dimensions.", parameterIds);
>     const archFront = d.archRearOffset+d.archLength;
>     // Adjacent uprights retain both member widths: 60 + 60 = 120 mm at baseline.
>     const postWidth = combineFrontPosts ? 2*w : w;
>     const postStart = combineFrontPosts ? length-postWidth : archFront+d.archClearance;
>     const postEnd = postStart+postWidth;
>     const frontClearance = postStart-archFront;
>     if (rearSupportEnd < w || frontClearance < d.archClearance ||
>         (!combineFrontPosts && postEnd > length-w))
>         throw regenError("Wheel arch and clearances leave insufficient room for the wall-side supports.", parameterIds);
>     if (d.archHeight > height-w)
>         throw regenError("Wheel arch reaches above the underside of the wall-side top band.", parameterIds);
>     const origin = vector(frameX,y+setback,0*millimeter);
>     // Retain the inner-frame plane so it meets the existing end panels.
>     fCuboid(context, id+"plate", {
>         "corner1" : origin,
>         "corner2" : origin+vector(d.frameThickness,length-setback,height)
>     });
>     const frame = qCreatedBy(id+"plate",EntityType.BODY);
>     const openings = combineFrontPosts ? [[rearSupportEnd,postStart]] : [[rearSupportEnd,postStart],[postEnd,length-w]];
>     for (var i = 0; i < size(openings); i += 1)
>     {
>         const bounds = openings[i];
>         const gap = bounds[1]-bounds[0];
>         if (gap > 0*millimeter)
>         {
>             const radius = d.insideRadius;
>             if (gap <= 2*radius || height-w <= 2*radius)
>                 throw regenError("Wall-side opening is too small for the specified corner radius.", parameterIds);
>             const endClearance = min(rearClearance,frontClearance);
>             if (i == 0 && endClearance < radius)
>             {
>                 const cornerHeight = height-w-radius+
>                     sqrt(radius^2-(radius-endClearance)^2);
>                 if (d.archHeight > cornerHeight)
>                     throw regenError("Wheel arch intersects the rounded opening corners.", parameterIds);
>             }
>             const cutId = id+("opening" ~ i);
>             openingTool(context,cutId,origin-vector(1,0,0)*millimeter,
>                 vector(0,1,0),vector(1,0,0),bounds[0]-setback,bounds[1]-setback,-2*radius,height-w,
>                 radius,d.frameThickness+2*millimeter);
>             opBoolean(context,cutId+"subtract",{
>                 "tools":qCreatedBy(cutId+"solid",EntityType.BODY),
>                 "targets":frame,"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION
>             });
>         }
>     }
>     nameAndColor(context,frame,name ~ " wall-side frame - wheel-arch opening",color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_rearWallSupportWidth",rearSupportEnd-setback);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_rearWallSupportStart",y+setback);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_rearWallSupportEnd",y+rearSupportEnd);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_rearArchClearance",rearClearance);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_frontArchClearance",frontClearance);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_rearCornerSetback",setback);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_wallPostStart",y+postStart);
>     setVariable(context,variablePrefix ~ "_wallPostEnd",y+postEnd);
> }
>
>
> /** Closed-bottom frame with a continuous slide mounting band and two access openings. */
> function slideMountFrame(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, origin is Vector,
>     along is Vector, normal is Vector, length, height, d is map)
> {
>     const w=d.memberWidth;
>     const r=d.insideRadius;
>     const bay=(length-3*w)/2;
>     if (bay <= 2*r || height-w-d.drawerMountBand <= 2*r)
>         throw regenError("Slide frame needs room for its lower band, upper band and rounded openings.",
>             ["drawerFrameHeight","drawerMountBand","memberWidth","insideRadius","seatLength"]);
>     fCuboid(context,id+"plate",{"corner1":origin,
>         "corner2":origin+along*length+normal*d.frameThickness+vector(0,0,1)*height});
>     const plate=qCreatedBy(id+"plate",EntityType.BODY);
>     for (var i=0; i<2; i+=1)
>     {
>         const cutId=id+("opening" ~ i);
>         const start=w+i*(bay+w);
>         openingTool(context,cutId,origin-normal*millimeter,along,normal,
>             start,start+bay,d.drawerMountBand,height-w,r,d.frameThickness+2*millimeter);
>         opBoolean(context,cutId+"subtract",{"tools":qCreatedBy(cutId+"solid",EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":plate,"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>     }
>     nameAndColor(context,plate,name,color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
> }
>
> /** Width follows the arch, mounting frame, runners and fixed aisle frame. */
> function drawerDimensions(d is map) returns map
> {
>     const f=d.frameThickness;
>     const p=d.drawerPly;
>     const total=d.wallThickness+f;
>     const frameX=(d.cargoWidth-d.archGap)/2+d.drawerArchClearance;
>     const left=frameX+f+d.slideThickness;
>     const right=d.longBenchWidth-f-d.slideThickness;
>     const headerBottom=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness-d.memberWidth;
>     const rearLeft=d.rearCornerRadius+d.rearCornerAllowance;
>     const drawerTop=d.drawerFloorClearance+d.drawerHeight;
>     const frameEnd=d.seatLength-total;
>     const slideBottom=d.drawerFloorClearance+p;
>     // Retain the saved runner length/setback inputs; tray rear face is fixed to the bench datum Y=0.
>     const trayLength=d.drawerRearSetback+d.drawerLength;
>     if (d.memberWidth < f)
>         throw regenError("Rear posts must cover the full rear header thickness and offset.",
>             ["memberWidth","wallThickness","frameThickness"]);
>     const ids=["longBenchWidth","archGap","drawerArchClearance","frameThickness","slideThickness",
>         "drawerPly","drawerLength","drawerHeight","drawerRearSetback","drawerFloorClearance"];
>     if (right-left <= 2*p || d.drawerLength <= 2*d.memberWidth+2*d.insideRadius ||
>         d.drawerHeight <= d.drawerSideBand+d.insideRadius || d.drawerSideBand <= p)
>         throw regenError("Drawer dimensions leave insufficient room inside the tray or its U-shaped sides.",ids);
>     if (d.drawerRearSetback < total || trayLength >= frameEnd)
>         throw regenError("Closed drawer and slides must clear the cab-end frame.",ids);
>     if (drawerTop >= headerBottom || d.drawerFrameHeight >= d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness-2*f)
>         throw regenError("Drawer or mounting frame reaches the rear header or sliding-bed guide ledges.",
>             ["drawerHeight","drawerFloorClearance","drawerFrameHeight","platformHeight","slatThickness","memberWidth"]);
>     if (slideBottom+d.slideHeight > min(d.drawerMountBand,d.drawerFloorClearance+d.drawerSideBand))
>         throw regenError("Slide profile must fit on both continuous mounting bands.",
>             ["slideHeight","drawerMountBand","drawerSideBand","drawerFloorClearance","drawerPly"]);
>     if (frameX <= max(total,rearLeft) || frameX+f >= right)
>         throw regenError("Internal slide frame must clear the rear corner and leave a drawer opening.",ids);
>     if (d.slideTravel < d.drawerLength || d.slideTravel >= 2*d.drawerLength)
>         throw regenError("Slide travel must provide full extension while retaining telescoping overlap.",["slideTravel","drawerLength"]);
>     if (d.drawerRearSetback < 50*millimeter)
>         throw regenError("The selected slide needs 50 mm rear allowance for its release lever.",["drawerRearSetback"]);
>     return {"frameX":frameX,"left":left,"right":right,"width":right-left,
>         "insideWidth":right-left-2*p,"insideLength":trayLength-2*p,"trayLength":trayLength,
>         "frameStart":0*millimeter,"frameEnd":frameEnd,"slideBottom":slideBottom,
>         "rearHeaderClearance":headerBottom-drawerTop};
> }
>
> /** Rear opening spans the slide gap. Existing aisle post and raised inner-frame post support the header. */
> function drawerRearFrame(context is Context, id is Id, width, height, d is map)
> {
>     const p=drawerDimensions(d);
>     makeBlock(context,id+"plate","Long bench rear header - clear drawer exit",
>         vector(p.frameX+d.frameThickness,p.frameStart,height-d.memberWidth),
>         vector(width-d.frameThickness,p.frameStart+d.frameThickness,height),color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
> }
>
> /** Five separate plywood tray pieces; bottom is flush with the underside of all four walls. */
> function rearDrawer(context is Context, id is Id, d is map)
> {
>     const p=drawerDimensions(d);
>     const zero=0*millimeter;
>     const ply=d.drawerPly;
>     const shift=d.drawerExtended ? d.slideTravel : zero;
>     const rear=p.frameStart-shift;
>     const front=rear+p.trayLength;
>     const bottom=d.drawerFloorClearance;
>     const top=bottom+d.drawerHeight;
>     const wood=color(0.78,0.65,0.44);
>     slideMountFrame(context,id+"mountFrame","Drawer fixed wall-side slide mounting frame",
>         vector(p.frameX,p.frameStart,zero),vector(0,1,0),vector(1,0,0),
>         p.frameEnd-p.frameStart,d.drawerFrameHeight,d);
>     // Raised rear post reaches slat level before the moving tie strip begins at the corner setback.
>     const bedFrameTop=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness;
>     const postEnd=d.memberWidth;
>     if (postEnd >= d.rearCornerRadius+d.rearCornerAllowance)
>         throw regenError("Raised drawer-frame rear post must end before the bed tie strip and guide ledge.",
>             ["memberWidth","rearCornerRadius","rearCornerAllowance"]);
>     makeBlock(context,id+"raisedPost","Drawer fixed internal frame - raised rear post",
>         vector(p.frameX,zero,d.drawerFrameHeight),
>         vector(p.frameX+d.frameThickness,postEnd,bedFrameTop),color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
>     opBoolean(context,id+"joinPost",{"tools":qUnion([
>         qCreatedBy(id+"mountFrame"+"plate",EntityType.BODY),qCreatedBy(id+"raisedPost",EntityType.BODY)]),
>         "operationType":BooleanOperationType.UNION});
>     nameAndColor(context,qCreatedBy(id+"mountFrame"+"plate",EntityType.BODY),
>         "Drawer fixed wall-side slide frame with raised rear post",color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
>     makeBlock(context,id+"bottom","Drawer bottom - flush inset",
>         vector(p.left+ply,rear+ply,bottom),vector(p.right-ply,front-ply,bottom+ply),wood);
>     for (var i=0; i<2; i+=1)
>     {
>         const x=i==0 ? p.left : p.right-ply;
>         const side=id+("side" ~ i);
>         makeBlock(context,side+"plate",i==0 ? "Drawer wall-side U panel" : "Drawer aisle-side U panel",
>             vector(x,rear,bottom),vector(x+ply,front,top),wood);
>         const cut=side+"opening";
>         openingTool(context,cut,vector(x-millimeter,rear,bottom),vector(0,1,0),vector(1,0,0),
>             d.memberWidth,p.trayLength-d.memberWidth,d.drawerSideBand,d.drawerHeight+2*d.insideRadius,
>             d.insideRadius,ply+2*millimeter);
>         opBoolean(context,cut+"subtract",{"tools":qCreatedBy(cut+"solid",EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":qCreatedBy(side+"plate",EntityType.BODY),"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>     }
>     makeBlock(context,id+"rearEnd","Drawer rear end panel",
>         vector(p.left+ply,rear,bottom),vector(p.right-ply,rear+ply,top),wood);
>     makeBlock(context,id+"frontEnd","Drawer cab-facing end panel",
>         vector(p.left+ply,front-ply,bottom),vector(p.right-ply,front,top),wood);
>     // Simple telescoping clearance envelopes only. Three equal thickness zones are visual placeholders.
>     // The entire pair occupies the specified 19 mm installation gap on each side.
>     for (var side=0; side<2; side+=1)
>     {
>         const gapStart=side==0 ? p.left-d.slideThickness : p.right;
>         for (var stage=0; stage<3; stage+=1)
>         {
>             const x=gapStart+(side==0 ? stage : 2-stage)*d.slideThickness/3;
>             const y=d.drawerRearSetback-shift*stage/2;
>             makeBlock(context,id+("slide" ~ side ~ "stage" ~ stage),
>                 (side==0 ? "Left" : "Right") ~ " drawer slide - clearance envelope stage " ~ stage,
>                 vector(x,y,p.slideBottom),vector(x+d.slideThickness/3,y+d.drawerLength,p.slideBottom+d.slideHeight),
>                 color(0.52,0.56,0.60));
>         }
>     }
>     for (var key,value in p) setVariable(context,"nv200_drawer_" ~ key,value);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_drawerPosition",shift);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_drawerInternalHeight",d.drawerHeight-ply);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_drawerFloorTop",bottom+ply);
> }
>
> /** End walls fit the actual side build-ups: exposed frames sit at the nominal aisle boundary. */
> function benchCarcass(context is Context, id is Id, name is string, x, y, width, length,
>     height, longBays is number, rightAccess is boolean, archSide is string, d is map)
> {
>     const zero = 0*millimeter;
>     const parameterIds = archSide == "RIGHT" ?
>         ["wallThickness", "frameThickness", "memberWidth", "insideRadius", "cabinetHeight",
>          "cabinetOuterLength", "cargoWidth", "bedWidth", "rearCornerRadius", "rearCornerAllowance"] :
>         ["wallThickness", "frameThickness", "memberWidth", "insideRadius", "platformHeight",
>          "slatThickness", "longBenchWidth", "seatLength", "cargoLength", "bedWidth"];
>     const total = d.wallThickness+d.frameThickness;
>     const leftInset = archSide == "RIGHT" && rightAccess ? d.frameThickness : total;
>     const rightInset = archSide != "RIGHT" && rightAccess ? d.frameThickness : total;
>     if (width <= leftInset+rightInset || length <= 2*total)
>         throw regenError("Carcass width and length must leave room between opposing walls and frames.",
>             parameterIds);
>     const variablePrefix = archSide == "RIGHT" ? "nv200_cabinet" : "nv200";
>     if (archSide == "LEFT")
>         wheelArchFrame(context,id+"left",name,variablePrefix,x+d.wallThickness,y,length,height,false,d);
>     else
>         benchWall(context, id+"left", name ~ (archSide == "RIGHT" ? " aisle side" : " wall side"),
>             vector(x,y,zero),vector(0,1,0),vector(1,0,0),length,height,longBays,
>             archSide == "RIGHT" && rightAccess,d,parameterIds);
>     if (archSide == "RIGHT")
>         wheelArchFrame(context,id+"right",name,variablePrefix,x+width-total,y,length,height,true,d);
>     else if (archSide == "LEFT")
>         slideMountFrame(context,id+"right","Long bench fixed aisle frame - slide mounting band",
>             vector(x+width,y+length,zero),vector(0,-1,0),vector(-1,0,0),length,height,d);
>     else
>         benchWall(context, id+"right", name ~ " aisle side", vector(x+width,y+length,zero),
>             vector(0,-1,0), vector(-1,0,0), length,height,longBays,rightAccess,d,parameterIds);
>     const setback = max(total,d.rearCornerRadius+d.rearCornerAllowance);
>     const rearLeft = archSide == "LEFT" ? setback : leftInset;
>     const rearRight = archSide == "RIGHT" ? setback : rightInset;
>     if (archSide == "LEFT")
>         drawerRearFrame(context,id+"rear",width,height,d);
>     else benchWall(context, id+"rear", name ~ " rear end", vector(x+width-rearRight,y,zero),
>         vector(-1,0,0), vector(0,1,0), width-rearLeft-rearRight,height,1,false,d,parameterIds);
>     benchWall(context, id+"front", name ~ " cab end", vector(x+leftInset,y+length,zero),
>         vector(1,0,0), vector(0,-1,0), width-leftInset-rightInset,height,1,false,d,parameterIds);
> }
>
> /** Shared dimensions for the sliding comb; invalid travel is rejected rather than resizing parts. */
> function longSlatDimensions(d is map) returns map
> {
>     const f = d.frameThickness;
>     const wallInner = d.wallThickness+f;
>     const fixedInner = d.longBenchWidth-f;
>     const closedWidth = d.longBenchWidth+f;
>     const travel = d.bedWidth-closedWidth;
>     const stripClosed = fixedInner-d.slidingStripWidth-travel;
>     const setback = max(wallInner,d.rearCornerRadius+d.rearCornerAllowance);
>     const stripRear = setback+d.stripEndClearance;
>     const stripFront = d.seatLength-wallInner-d.stripEndClearance;
>     const pitch = d.slatWidth+d.slatSideGap;
>     var count = floor((d.seatLength-d.slatSideGap)/pitch);
>     if (count % 2 == 0) count -= 1;
>     const margin = (d.seatLength-(count*d.slatWidth+(count-1)*d.slatSideGap))/2;
>     if (travel <= 0*millimeter || stripClosed < wallInner+d.slatSideGap-0.00001*millimeter)
>         throw regenError("The inner strip cannot retract between the fixed frames. Reduce bed width or strip width, or increase fixed bench width.",
>             ["longBenchWidth","bedWidth","frameThickness","wallThickness","slidingStripWidth","slatSideGap"]);
>     if (count < 3 || count > 101)
>         throw regenError("Long bench must accommodate between 3 and 101 interleaving slats.",
>             ["seatLength","slatWidth","slatSideGap"]);
>     if (d.stripEndClearance >= d.ledgeWidth || setback+d.ledgeWidth >= d.seatLength-wallInner-d.ledgeWidth)
>         throw regenError("Ledges need positive strip bearing and clear space between them.",
>             ["ledgeWidth","stripEndClearance","seatLength","rearCornerRadius","rearCornerAllowance"]);
>     for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 2)
>     {
>         const slatY = margin+i*pitch;
>         if (slatY < setback && slatY >= d.memberWidth)
>             throw regenError("A shortened rear slat misses the rear end support. Adjust slat width, side clearance or bench length.",
>                 ["slatWidth","slatSideGap","seatLength","rearCornerRadius","rearCornerAllowance"]);
>     }
>     const firstMoving = margin+pitch;
>     const lastMoving = margin+(count-2)*pitch;
>     if (firstMoving+d.slatWidth <= stripRear || lastMoving >= stripFront)
>         throw regenError("The end moving slats must overlap the inner strip. Adjust slat spacing or rear corner setback.",
>             ["slatWidth","slatSideGap","seatLength","rearCornerRadius","rearCornerAllowance","stripEndClearance"]);
>     if (d.frameThickness*2 > d.memberWidth || d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness-2*f <= d.archHeight)
>         throw regenError("Strip and ledges need room within the top band and above the wheel arch.",
>             ["frameThickness","memberWidth","platformHeight","slatThickness","archHeight"]);
>     var slats=[];
>     for(var i=0;i<count;i+=1) {
>         const y=margin+i*pitch;
>         slats=append(slats,{"y":y,"width":d.slatWidth,
>             "fixedStart":y<setback ? drawerDimensions(d).frameX:d.wallThickness});
>     }
>     return {
>         "fixedWidth":d.longBenchWidth,"length":d.seatLength,"startY":0*millimeter,"endY":d.seatLength,
>         "bracketTopCutStart":d.longBenchWidth-f,
>         "bays":2,"slats":slats,"movingStart":d.wallThickness,
>         "count":count,"margin":margin,"pitch":pitch,"travel":travel,"closedWidth":closedWidth,
>         "wallInner":wallInner,"ledgeStartX":wallInner,"fixedInner":fixedInner,"stripClosed":stripClosed,
>         "stripRear":stripRear,"stripFront":stripFront,"rearLedge":setback
>     };
> }
>
> /** Separate fixed and moving slats, a copied aisle frame, an inner stop strip and two fixed ledges. */
> function slidingSlatAssembly(context is Context, id is Id, d is map, p is map, name is string, showSlats is boolean)
> {
>     const zero = 0*millimeter;
>     const f = d.frameThickness;
>     const h = d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness;
>     const shift = !d.daytime ? p.travel : zero;
>     const wood = color(0.72,0.52,0.32);
>     const movingWood = color(0.87,0.70,0.43);
>     for (var i = 0; showSlats && i < p.count; i += 1)
>     {
>         const y = p.slats[i].y;
>         const moving = i % 2 == 1;
>         const start = moving ? p.movingStart+shift :
>             (p.storage!=undefined ? p.storage.fixedDeckStart:p.slats[i].fixedStart);
>         const end = moving ? p.closedWidth+shift : p.closedWidth;
>         makeBlock(context,id+(moving ? "movingSlat" ~ i : "fixedSlat" ~ i),
>             (name ~ (moving ? " moving slat " : " fixed slat ")) ~ (i+1),
>             vector(start,y,h),vector(end,y+p.slats[i].width,d.platformHeight),moving ? movingWood : wood);
>         if(!moving && p.storage!=undefined)
>             makeBlock(context,id+("lidSlat" ~ i),"Cross bench removable lid slat " ~ (i+1),
>                 vector(max(p.slats[i].fixedStart,p.storage.lidStart),max(y,p.storage.lidRear),h),
>                 vector(p.storage.lidEnd,min(y+p.slats[i].width,p.storage.lidFront),d.platformHeight),wood);
>     }
>     benchWall(context,id+"movingFrame",name ~ " moving aisle support",
>         vector(p.closedWidth+shift,p.endY,zero),vector(0,-1,0),vector(-1,0,0),
>         p.length,h,p.bays,true,d,
>         ["seatLength","platformHeight","slatThickness","memberWidth","insideRadius","frameThickness"]);
>     if(p.hasDeck!=true)
>     {
>     makeBlock(context,id+"innerStrip",name ~ " moving inner tie / extension stop",
>         vector(p.stripClosed+shift,p.stripRear,h-f),
>         vector(p.stripClosed+shift+d.slidingStripWidth,p.stripFront,h),movingWood);
>     // Rear ledge is inset to the corner setback, joining the retained wall post and fixed aisle frame.
>     makeBlock(context,id+"rearLedge",name ~ " fixed rear guide ledge",
>         vector(p.ledgeStartX,p.rearLedge,h-2*f),
>         vector(p.fixedInner,p.rearLedge+d.ledgeWidth,h-f),wood);
>     makeBlock(context,id+"frontLedge",name ~ " fixed cab-end guide ledge",
>         vector(p.ledgeStartX,p.endY-p.wallInner-d.ledgeWidth,h-2*f),
>         vector(p.fixedInner,p.endY-p.wallInner,h-f),wood);
>     }
> }
>
> function longitudinalSlats(context is Context,id is Id,d is map)
> {
>     const p=longSlatDimensions(d);
>     const shift=d.daytime ? 0*millimeter:p.travel;
>     slidingSlatAssembly(context,id,d,p,"Long bench",d.showSlats);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longSlatCount",p.count);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longSlideTravel",p.travel);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longSlidePosition",shift);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longBenchClosedWidth",p.closedWidth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longBenchCurrentWidth",p.closedWidth+shift);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longStripClosedClearance",p.stripClosed-p.wallInner);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longSlatGap",d.slatSideGap);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_longFixedSlatGap",d.slatWidth+2*d.slatSideGap);
> }
>
> function crossSlatDimensions(d is map) returns map
> {
>     const layout=layoutDimensions(d);
>     const width=layout.crossSeatWidth;
>     const length=layout.dLength;
>     const wallInner=d.wallThickness+d.frameThickness;
>     const closedWidth=width+d.frameThickness;
>     const travel=d.bedWidth-closedWidth;
>     const fixedInner=width-d.frameThickness;
>     const longSlats=longSlatDimensions(d);
>     const overlap=longSlats.closedWidth-longSlats.movingStart-longSlats.travel;
>     const movingStart=closedWidth-travel-overlap;
>     if(overlap<=d.frameThickness || movingStart<d.wallThickness)
>         throw regenError("Cross slats need positive deck overlap while matching the long bench overlap.",
>             ["bedWidth","longBenchWidth","frameThickness","wallThickness"]);
>     // Keep all moving slats full width. Trim the two fixed end slats equally to fill the depth.
>     var count=ceil((length+d.slatSideGap)/(d.slatWidth+d.slatSideGap));
>     if(count%2==0) count+=1;
>     var edgeWidth=(length-(count-2)*d.slatWidth-(count-1)*d.slatSideGap)/2;
>     var margin=0*millimeter;
>     // If the next odd count produces unusably narrow end strips, use full-width slats with small end margins.
>     if(edgeWidth<=d.frameThickness) {
>         count-=2;
>         edgeWidth=d.slatWidth;
>         margin=(length-count*d.slatWidth-(count-1)*d.slatSideGap)/2;
>     }
>     if(count<7 || count>101 || edgeWidth<=d.frameThickness || edgeWidth>d.slatWidth ||
>         travel<=0*millimeter || d.crossDeckThickness<=d.bracketThickness+max(d.bracketHeadAllowance,d.bracketBendRadius)+d.bracketClearance)
>         throw regenError("Cross bench cannot fit its slats, or the deck is too thin for bracket clearance recesses.",
>             ["cargoLength","seatLength","slatWidth","slatSideGap","frameThickness","bedWidth","longBenchWidth"]);
>     var slats=[];
>     var y=d.seatLength+margin;
>     for(var i=0;i<count;i+=1) {
>         const sw=(i==0 || i==count-1) ? edgeWidth:d.slatWidth;
>         slats=append(slats,{"y":y,"width":sw,"fixedStart":d.wallThickness});
>         y+=sw+d.slatSideGap;
>     }
>     return {"fixedWidth":width,"length":length,"startY":d.seatLength,"endY":d.cargoLength,
>         "bays":1,"slats":slats,"count":count,"travel":travel,"closedWidth":closedWidth,
>         "movingStart":movingStart,"overlap":overlap,
>         "wallInner":wallInner,"fixedInner":fixedInner,"hasDeck":true,
>         "bracketTopCutStart":width-d.bracketArm,
>         "edgeWidth":edgeWidth,"margin":margin};
> }
>
> /** Partition position reserves the assumed toilet depth along its aisle-facing pull-out direction. */
> function crossStorageDimensions(d is map,p is map) returns map
> {
>     const total=d.wallThickness+d.frameThickness;
>     const bayDepth=d.toiletDepth+d.toiletBayAllowance;
>     const toiletFace=p.fixedInner-bayDepth;
>     const storageFace=toiletFace-total;
>     const seam=storageFace+d.frameThickness/2;
>     const lidEnd=seam-d.storageLidGap/2;
>     const fixedDeckStart=seam+d.storageLidGap/2;
>     const rear=p.startY+total;
>     const front=p.endY-total;
>     const top=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness-d.crossDeckThickness;
>     const fingerX=(total+storageFace)/2;
>     const middleMoving=2*floor(((p.count-1)/2-1)/2)+1;
>     const fingerY=p.slats[middleMoving].y+p.slats[middleMoving].width/2;
>     if(storageFace<=total+d.storageLidFingerDiameter+2*d.storageLidGap ||
>         d.storageLidGap<=0*millimeter || d.storageLidGap>=d.frameThickness/2 ||
>         d.storageLidGap>=d.wallThickness || lidEnd+d.storageLidGap>p.movingStart ||
>         d.toiletBayAllowance<0*millimeter ||
>         d.toiletWidth+2*d.bracketClearance>p.length-2*d.memberWidth-2*d.insideRadius ||
>         d.storageLidFingerDiameter+2*d.storageLidGap>d.slatWidth ||
>         fingerY-d.storageLidFingerDiameter/2<=rear || fingerY+d.storageLidFingerDiameter/2>=front)
>         throw regenError("Storage lid, divider and assumed toilet footprint must fit between the frames and clear the moving slats.",
>             ["toiletDepth","toiletWidth","toiletBayAllowance","storageLidGap","storageLidFingerDiameter","cargoLength","seatLength","longBenchWidth","bedWidth"]);
>     return {"toiletFace":toiletFace,"storageFace":storageFace,"seam":seam,"fixedDeckStart":fixedDeckStart,
>         "lidStart":d.storageLidGap,"lidEnd":lidEnd,"lidRear":p.startY+d.storageLidGap,
>         "lidFront":p.endY-d.storageLidGap,"rear":rear,"front":front,"top":top,
>         "clearStorageWidth":storageFace-total,"clearStorageDepth":front-rear,"bayDepth":bayDepth,
>         "fingerX":fingerX,"fingerY":fingerY};
> }
>
> function crossBenchPartition(context is Context,id is Id,d is map)
> {
>     const p=crossSlatDimensions(d);
>     const s=crossStorageDimensions(d,p);
>     const rear=s.rear-d.frameThickness;
>     const front=s.front+d.frameThickness;
>     const innerWidth=front-rear-2*d.memberWidth;
>     const innerHeight=s.top-2*d.memberWidth;
>     if(innerWidth<=2*d.insideRadius || innerHeight<=2*d.insideRadius || d.memberWidth<=d.frameThickness)
>         throw regenError("Divider needs a rectangular centre opening and material beneath both cross-beam recesses.",
>             ["memberWidth","frameThickness","insideRadius","platformHeight","cargoLength","seatLength"]);
>     makeBlock(context,id+"layer0"+"plate","Cross bench toilet / storage divider - separating panel",
>         vector(s.toiletFace-d.wallThickness,rear,0*millimeter),vector(s.toiletFace,front,s.top),color(0.75,0.66,0.49));
>     makeBlock(context,id+"layer1"+"plate","Cross bench toilet / storage divider - rectangular frame",
>         vector(s.storageFace,rear,0*millimeter),vector(s.toiletFace-d.wallThickness,front,s.top),color(0.88,0.61,0.25));
>     // +X normal and +Y sketch direction keep the opening's vertical axis pointing UP.
>     const opening=id+"centerOpening";
>     openingTool(context,opening,vector(s.storageFace-millimeter,rear,0*millimeter),
>         vector(0,1,0),vector(1,0,0),d.memberWidth,front-rear-d.memberWidth,
>         d.memberWidth,s.top-d.memberWidth,d.insideRadius,d.frameThickness+2*millimeter);
>     opBoolean(context,id+"cutCenter",{"tools":qCreatedBy(opening+"solid",EntityType.BODY),
>         "targets":qCreatedBy(id+"layer1"+"plate",EntityType.BODY),"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>     // Both layers share the two top-corner notches around the existing end-frame cross beams.
>     for(var n=0;n<2;n+=1)
>     {
>         const y=n==0?rear:s.front;
>         const cut=id+("beamRecess" ~ n);
>         fCuboid(context,cut,{"corner1":vector(s.storageFace-millimeter,y,s.top-d.memberWidth),
>             "corner2":vector(s.toiletFace+millimeter,y+d.frameThickness,s.top+millimeter)});
>         opBoolean(context,id+("cutBeamRecess" ~ n),{"tools":qCreatedBy(cut,EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":qUnion([qCreatedBy(id+"layer0"+"plate",EntityType.BODY),qCreatedBy(id+"layer1"+"plate",EntityType.BODY)]),
>             "operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>     }
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStorageClearWidth",s.clearStorageWidth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStorageClearDepth",s.clearStorageDepth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossToiletBayDepth",s.bayDepth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossToiletOpeningHeight",s.top-d.memberWidth);
> }
>
> function crossBenchSlats(context is Context,id is Id,d is map)
> {
>     var p=crossSlatDimensions(d);
>     const storage=crossStorageDimensions(d,p);
>     p.storage=storage;
>     slidingSlatAssembly(context,id,d,p,"Cross bench",d.showSlats);
>     const h=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness;
>     makeBlock(context,id+"deck","Cross bench fixed plywood deck",
>         vector(storage.fixedDeckStart,p.startY,h-d.crossDeckThickness),
>         vector(p.fixedWidth,p.endY,h),color(0.75,0.66,0.49));
>     if(d.showSlats)
>     {
>         makeBlock(context,id+"lid","Cross bench removable storage lid - attach wall-side slat sections",
>             vector(storage.lidStart,storage.lidRear,h-d.crossDeckThickness),
>             vector(storage.lidEnd,storage.lidFront,h),color(0.78,0.70,0.53));
>         fCylinder(context,id+"fingerTool",{"bottomCenter":vector(storage.fingerX,storage.fingerY,h-d.crossDeckThickness-millimeter),
>             "topCenter":vector(storage.fingerX,storage.fingerY,h+millimeter),"radius":d.storageLidFingerDiameter/2});
>         opBoolean(context,id+"fingerCut",{"tools":qCreatedBy(id+"fingerTool",EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":qCreatedBy(id+"lid",EntityType.BODY),"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>     }
>     if(d.showSlats && d.openStorageLid)
>     {
>         var lidParts=[qCreatedBy(id+"lid",EntityType.BODY)];
>         for(var i=0;i<p.count;i+=2)
>             lidParts=append(lidParts,qCreatedBy(id+("lidSlat" ~ i),EntityType.BODY));
>         // Axis along X at the cab-side top edge; negative rotation lifts the rear/free edge.
>         opTransform(context,id+"openLid",{"bodies":qUnion(lidParts),
>             "transform":rotationAround(line(vector(0*millimeter,storage.lidFront,d.platformHeight),vector(1,0,0)),-70*degree)});
>     }
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStorageLidAngle",d.openStorageLid?70*degree:0*degree);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStorageLidWidth",storage.lidEnd-storage.lidStart);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStorageLidDepth",storage.lidFront-storage.lidRear);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossSlatCount",p.count);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossEndSlatWidth",p.edgeWidth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossSlideTravel",p.travel);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossSlidePosition",d.daytime ? 0*millimeter:p.travel);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossBenchClosedWidth",p.closedWidth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossSlatEndMargin",p.margin);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossMovingSlatLength",p.closedWidth-p.movingStart);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossExtendedSlatOverlap",p.overlap);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossMovingSlatClosedStart",p.movingStart);
> }
>
> /** Three bracket positions follow moving slats; allowances are editable, unmeasured hardware envelopes. */
> function slidingBracketDimensions(d is map,p is map) returns map
> {
>     const movingCount=(p.count-1)/2;
>     const reach=max(d.bracketHeadAllowance,d.bracketBendRadius);
>     const depth=d.bracketThickness+reach+d.bracketClearance;
>     if (p.hasDeck!=true && p.stripClosed+d.slidingStripWidth+d.bracketClearance>p.fixedWidth-d.bracketArm)
>         throw regenError("Bracket arms need more separation from the moving inner strip. Increase bed extension or reduce bracket arm length.",
>             ["bedWidth","longBenchWidth","bracketArm","frameThickness","bracketClearance"]);
>     if (movingCount<3 || d.bracketWidth+2*d.bracketClearance>d.slatWidth ||
>         d.bracketArm+d.bracketClearance>=d.memberWidth || depth>=d.frameThickness ||
>         d.bracketThickness<=0*millimeter || d.bracketBendRadius<=0*millimeter ||
>         d.bracketThickness+d.bracketBendRadius>=d.bracketArm ||
>         d.bracketHeadAllowance<0*millimeter || d.bracketClearance<=0*millimeter)
>         throw regenError("Brackets need three moving slats, width clearance, and positive frame material below and behind their pockets.",
>             ["bracketWidth","bracketArm","bracketThickness","bracketBendRadius","bracketHeadAllowance","bracketClearance","memberWidth","frameThickness","slatWidth"]);
>     var centers=[];
>     for (var n in [0,floor((movingCount-1)/2),movingCount-1])
>         centers=append(centers,p.slats[2*n+1].y+p.slats[2*n+1].width/2);
>     return {"centers":centers,"pocketDepth":depth,
>         "notchWidth":d.bracketWidth+2*d.bracketClearance,
>         "headReach":reach,"height":d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness};
> }
>
> function slideBracketDimensions(d is map) returns map
> {
>     return slidingBracketDimensions(d,longSlatDimensions(d));
> }
>
> /** Bent steel envelope; hole positions and actual bend radius await a physical bracket. */
> function slideAngleBracket(context is Context,id is Id,x,y,d is map)
> {
>     const h=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness;
>     const a=d.bracketArm;
>     const t=d.bracketThickness;
>     const r=d.bracketBendRadius;
>     const sketch=newSketchOnPlane(context,id+"profile",{
>         "sketchPlane":plane(vector(0*millimeter,y+d.bracketWidth/2,0*millimeter),vector(0,-1,0),vector(1,0,0))});
>     const points=[vector(x,h),vector(x-a,h),vector(x-a,h-t),vector(x-t-r,h-t)];
>     for(var i=0;i<3;i+=1)
>         skLineSegment(sketch,"edge" ~ i,{"start":points[i],"end":points[i+1]});
>     skArc(sketch,"insideBend",{"start":vector(x-t-r,h-t),
>         "mid":vector(x-t-r+r/sqrt(2),h-t-r+r/sqrt(2)),"end":vector(x-t,h-t-r)});
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"verticalInside",{"start":vector(x-t,h-t-r),"end":vector(x-t,h-a)});
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"bottom",{"start":vector(x-t,h-a),"end":vector(x,h-a)});
>     skLineSegment(sketch,"verticalOutside",{"start":vector(x,h-a),"end":vector(x,h)});
>     skSolve(sketch);

> function slidingBenchBrackets(context is Context,id is Id,fixed is Query,d is map,p is map)
> {
>     const b=slidingBracketDimensions(d,p);
>     const shift=d.daytime ? 0*millimeter:p.travel;
>     const h=b.height;
>     for(var i=0;i<3;i+=1)
>     {
>         const part=id+("bracket" ~ i);
>         const y=b.centers[i];
>         slideAngleBracket(context,part,p.fixedWidth+shift,y,d);
>         const loY=y-b.notchWidth/2;
>         const hiY=y+b.notchWidth/2;
>         const topCut=id+("topCut" ~ i);
>         fCuboid(context,topCut,{"corner1":vector(p.bracketTopCutStart-d.bracketClearance,loY,h-b.pocketDepth),
>             "corner2":vector(p.fixedWidth+d.bracketClearance,hiY,h+d.bracketClearance)});
>         opBoolean(context,id+("topNotch" ~ i),{"tools":qCreatedBy(topCut,EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":fixed,"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>         const faceCut=id+("faceCut" ~ i);
>         fCuboid(context,faceCut,{"corner1":vector(p.fixedWidth-b.pocketDepth,loY,h-d.bracketArm-d.bracketClearance),
>             "corner2":vector(p.fixedWidth+d.bracketClearance,hiY,h+d.bracketClearance)});
>         opBoolean(context,id+("facePocket" ~ i),{"tools":qCreatedBy(faceCut,EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":fixed,"operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>     }
>
> }

> /** Two transverse plates travel in closed-ended rebates beneath neighbouring fixed slats.
>  * Plate thickness and screw projection are provisional; no product hole pattern is assumed.
>  */
> function crossStopDimensions(d is map) returns map
> {
>     const p=crossSlatDimensions(d);
>     const x0=(p.movingStart+p.fixedWidth-p.travel)/2;
>     const x1=x0+p.travel;
>     const h=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness;
>     const embed=d.stopPlateLength/2;
>     const overlap=d.stopPlateLength-embed-d.slatSideGap;
>     const mountDepth=d.stopRecessDepth-d.stopRunningClearance;
>     const plateTop=h+mountDepth;
>     const plateBottom=plateTop-d.stopPlateThickness;
>     if(overlap<=d.stopRunningClearance || embed+d.stopRunningClearance>=d.slatWidth ||
>         overlap+d.stopRunningClearance>=p.edgeWidth || d.stopPlateWidth<=0*millimeter ||
>         d.stopPlateThickness<=0*millimeter || d.stopRunningClearance<=0*millimeter ||
>         d.stopHeadAllowance<0*millimeter || d.stopRecessDepth>=d.slatThickness ||
>         plateBottom-d.stopHeadAllowance<h+d.stopRunningClearance ||
>         x0-d.stopPlateWidth/2-d.stopRunningClearance<=p.movingStart ||
>         x1+d.stopPlateWidth/2+d.stopRunningClearance>=p.closedWidth ||
>         x1+d.stopPlateWidth/2>=p.fixedWidth-d.bracketArm-d.bracketClearance)
>         throw regenError("Plate stops need bearing inside both slats, closed recess ends, and clearance above the deck and away from the angle brackets.",
>             ["stopPlateLength","stopPlateWidth","stopPlateThickness","stopRecessDepth","stopRunningClearance","stopHeadAllowance","bedWidth","longBenchWidth"]);
>     return {"x0":x0,"x1":x1,"deckTop":h,"plateTop":plateTop,"plateBottom":plateBottom,
>         "mountDepth":mountDepth,"embed":embed,"overlap":overlap,
>         "movingIndices":[1,p.count-2],"fixedIndices":[0,p.count-1]};
> }
>
> function crossBenchStops(context is Context,root is Id,d is map)
> {
>     const id=root+"crossStops";
>     const p=crossSlatDimensions(d);
>     const s=crossStopDimensions(d);
>     const x=d.daytime?s.x0:s.x1;
>     const c=d.stopRunningClearance;
>     const half=d.stopPlateWidth/2;
>     for(var i=0;d.showSlats && i<2;i+=1)
>     {
>         const part=id+("stop" ~ i);
>         const movingIndex=s.movingIndices[i];
>         const fixedIndex=s.fixedIndices[i];
>         const edge=i==0?p.slats[movingIndex].y:p.slats[movingIndex].y+p.slats[movingIndex].width;
>         const lowY=i==0?edge-(d.stopPlateLength-s.embed):edge-s.embed;
>         const highY=lowY+d.stopPlateLength;
>         // Mounting pocket opens at the slat edge; the plate bears against its ceiling.
>         makeBlock(context,part+"mountTool","tool",
>             vector(x-half-c,i==0?edge-c:lowY-c,s.deckTop-millimeter),
>             vector(x+half+c,i==0?highY+c:edge+c,s.plateTop),color(0,0,0));
>         opBoolean(context,part+"mountCut",{"tools":qCreatedBy(part+"mountTool",EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":qCreatedBy(root+"crossSlats"+("movingSlat" ~ movingIndex),EntityType.BODY),
>             "operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>         // Exact longitudinal end faces give simultaneous contact at the day and night limits.
>         makeBlock(context,part+"guideTool","tool",
>             vector(s.x0-half,i==0?lowY-c:edge,s.deckTop-millimeter),
>             vector(s.x1+half,i==0?edge:highY+c,s.deckTop+d.stopRecessDepth),color(0,0,0));
>         opBoolean(context,part+"guideCut",{"tools":qCreatedBy(part+"guideTool",EntityType.BODY),
>             "targets":qCreatedBy(root+"crossSlats"+("fixedSlat" ~ fixedIndex),EntityType.BODY),
>             "operationType":BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION});
>         makeBlock(context,part+"plate","Cross bench recessed mending plate stop - thickness provisional",
>             vector(x-half,lowY,s.plateBottom),vector(x+half,highY,s.plateTop),color(0.60,0.65,0.70));
>     }
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStopTravel",p.travel);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStopRecessLength",p.travel+d.stopPlateWidth);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStopPlateOverlap",s.overlap);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossStopHeadDeckClearance",s.plateBottom-d.stopHeadAllowance-s.deckTop);
>     setVariable(context,"nv200_crossDeckUnderside",s.deckTop-d.crossDeckThickness);
> }
>
> /** Read the actual rear-facing planar boundary, including any applied body transforms. */
> function rearFaceY(context is Context, bodies is Query, heightBand is array)
> {
>     var rear=undefined;
>     for (var face in evaluateQuery(context,qGeometry(qOwnedByBody(bodies,EntityType.FACE),GeometryType.PLANE)))
>     {
>         const facePlane=evPlane(context,{"face":face});
>         const bounds=evBox3d(context,{"topology":face,"tight":true});
>         if (abs(dot(facePlane.normal,vector(0,1,0))) > 1-1e-8 &&
>             bounds.minCorner[2] <= heightBand[0]+0.001*millimeter &&
>             bounds.maxCorner[2] >= heightBand[1]-0.001*millimeter)
>             if (rear == undefined || facePlane.origin[1] < rear) rear=facePlane.origin[1];
>     }
>     if (rear == undefined) throw regenError("Rear alignment check cannot find a planar rear face.");
>     return rear;
> }
>
> /** Runs on the real generated bodies, with the current instance's inputs, on every regeneration. */
> function verifyRearAlignment(context is Context, id is Id, d is map)
> {
>     const top=d.platformHeight-d.slatThickness;
>     const supportBand=[top-d.memberWidth,top];
>     const drawerBand=[d.drawerFloorClearance,d.drawerFloorClearance+d.drawerHeight];
>     const datum=rearFaceY(context,qCreatedBy(id+"longBench"+"right",EntityType.BODY),supportBand);
>     const shift=d.drawerExtended ? d.slideTravel : 0*millimeter;
>     const checks=[
>         {"name":"drawer rear panel","query":qCreatedBy(id+"drawer"+"rearEnd",EntityType.BODY),"shift":shift,"band":drawerBand},
>         {"name":"rear crossbeam","query":qCreatedBy(id+"longBench"+"rear",EntityType.BODY),"shift":0*millimeter,"band":supportBand},
>         {"name":"internal rear support","query":qCreatedBy(id+"drawer"+"mountFrame"+"plate",EntityType.BODY),"shift":0*millimeter,"band":supportBand},
>         {"name":"moving bed rear support","query":qCreatedBy(id+"longSlats"+"movingFrame",EntityType.BODY),"shift":0*millimeter,"band":supportBand}
>     ];
>     for (var item in checks)
>     {
>         const offset=rearFaceY(context,item.query,item.band)+item.shift-datum;
>         if (abs(offset) > 0.001*millimeter)
>             throw regenError("Rear alignment failed: " ~ item.name ~ " is offset " ~
>                 (offset/millimeter) ~ " mm from the aisle support rear face.");
>     }
> }
>

**For your van, I’d shortlist the SCNZ 10L toilet with bracket at $179.99 and the Thetford Porta Potti 335 at $295.** Both are compact enough to work around; the Thetford has a smaller footprint and more useful operating features.

Prices checked today, **NZD including GST, excluding delivery**. Dimensions below are **width × depth × height**, with the lid closed; mounting hardware and operating clearances are additional.

Simple HDPE construction, detachable 10L waste tank, large emptying opening. Included bracket holds the upper section while the waste tank is removed. Limited evidence about long-term durability. |
| **[Kiwi Self Contained 10L](https://www.kiwiselfcontained.co.nz/products/compact-portable-toilet-10-litre-waste-tank)** | **$144.99**, available to order online; bracket extra | **350 × 415 × 300mm** | Similar basic arrangement: 10L fresh and waste tanks, detachable bottom tank, washable plastic surfaces. Dedicated Fix-a-Potty bracket available. Supplier lists it 15mm narrower than the SCNZ model; we should treat those as distinct dimensions. |
| **[Thetford Porta Potti 335](https://smilecaravans.co.nz/products/thetford-porta-potti-335-with-hold-down-kit)** | **$295**, orderable from Smile Caravans; NZ-wide shipping. Smaller footprint, although 13mm taller than the basic toilets. |
| **[BlackMOA 12L fixed cassette](https://www.mystenterprise.com/shop/nzcompliant-fixed-cassette-toilet-12l-330)** | Advertised **$450 sale**, orderable from Myst Enterprise; confirm checkout price because the page also displays another price | **400 × 470 × 330mm advertised**; FAQ says **400 × 480 × 335mm** | Convenient front-removable cassette while the toilet body stays mounted. 12L fresh/waste capacity, supplier offers spare parts and one-year warranty. GST**, white; supplier estimates approximately one week NZ-wide | **330 × 390 × 296mm** | No flushing water; separate 4.5L urine and 6.5L solids containers accessed from above. **3.9kg empty**. “Orderable” means the retailer currently accepts online orders; it does not confirm Wellington shelf stock.

**What the extra money buys:** the Thetford’s level indicator and pouring spout make monitoring and emptying more convenient. Its manufacturer also publishes replacement-parts documentation. Those are concrete advantages; I haven’t found comparable independent durability testing across these models. [Thetford specifications](https://www.thetford.com.au/shop/porta-potti-335-portable-toilet/), [replacement parts](https://www.thetford.com/app/uploads/SPL-Porta-Potti.pdf).

**For our sliding tray:**

- Our current **440mm compartment depth** accommodates the basic 415mm toilets and the 382mm Thetford body, before mounting clearances.
- The **310mm-high exit opening** needs attention. With a provisional 12mm tray and 5mm floor clearance, a 300mm toilet needs **317mm**, and the Thetford needs **330mm**, before running clearance.
- We can address that opening locally once the toilet is chosen, while retaining the **400mm bed surface**.
- Thetford’s included hold-down kit releases the whole toilet. We would need to establish a suitable fixing arrangement if Green Sticker certification is part of the brief. The budget bracket systems specifically allow the upper body to remain fixed during emptying.

**My pick for your priorities is the SCNZ package:** low price, 300mm height and a fixing bracket included. The Thetford 335 is worth considering if its smaller footprint and easier emptying justify roughly $115 extra, plus any required fixing adaptation.

**Then we should optimise for the cheapest, smallest installation that meets Green Sticker requirements.** There’s little value in paying extra for flushing features you’ll rarely use.

I’d narrow this to a **basic 10L toilet with a compatible fixing bracket**, with the **$179.99 SCNZ package** as the first candidate. Its body is **365 × 415 × 300mm**. The Thetford and Trelino drop off our shortlist. [SCNZ package](https://selfcontained.co.nz/products/10l-portable-toilet-with-bracket)

Two requirements matter for our design:

- **Sliding is permitted:** PGDB guidance explicitly allows appropriately fixed toilets on heavy-duty rails. The mounting must remain permanent, and emptying must work without removing the fixed toilet base. [PGDB guidance, §2.3](https://www.pgdb.co.nz/media/cqubmqa3/vehicle-inspection-guidance-v11.pdf)
- **Usability still matters despite rare use:** NZMCA explicitly requires practical use inside the vehicle with the beds down. We should design for that clearance. [NZMCA inspection guidance, B5](https://d1o3mhf2l0m2f4.cloudfront.net/page_builder_uploads/250902_Self-containment_guidance_document_Version_3.pdf)

**The remaining check is the exact toilet–bracket–tray arrangement.** A retailer’s compliance claim cannot guarantee the completed installation will pass. Before purchasing, we should give the intended certifier the product details and a drawing showing its mounting, waste-tank removal and usable position with the bed extended. That lets us settle the compliance details before building around it.

**Use the SCNZ toilet, and allow 20mm clearance above its closed lid.** I found a compact NZ slide option, but the extended bed creates a travel problem we need to resolve before choosing the slide length.

| Item | Proposed dimension |
|---|---:|
| Toilet body, width × depth × height | **365 × 415 × 300mm** |
| Tray floor thickness | **12mm** |
| Tray clearance above van floor | **5mm** |
| Extra clearance above toilet | **20mm** |
| Required opening height | **337mm — round to 340mm** |

That height assumes the fixing bracket adds no height beneath the toilet. Our current opening is **310mm**, so its top support needs revision. The bed surface can remain at **400mm**.

**Slide candidate:** [UES DSCHMD400MML locking slides](https://www.ues-hardware.co.nz/drawer-slides/drawer-slides/medium-duty-lockable/drawer-slides-medium-duty-400mm-locking-125kg-pair-dschmd400mml).

| Specification | Published value |
|---|---:|
| Closed length | **400mm** |
| Extension | Full extension |
| Slide height | **53mm** |
| Mounting gap per side | **18.7 ±0.3mm** |
| Pair capacity | **125kg** |
| Pair weight | **2.16kg** |
| Current displayed price | **$32.09 incl. GST**, promotional |
| NZ availability | Orderable from UES NZ, Auckland |

They mount **vertically beside the tray**, so their 53mm height does not raise the toilet by 53mm. [Mounting drawing](https://www.ues-hardware.co.nz/images/ProductImages/DSCHMD400MML_5.jpg)

For load, **85kg occupant + 20kg liquid + approximately 10kg allowance for toilet, bracket and tray = 115kg**. The published rating covers that static estimate, with a modest margin. It does not establish suitability for someone dropping heavily onto the seat.

**The unresolved issue is extension distance.** The cross-bed extends another **217mm** into the aisle. A 400mm slide would leave much of the toilet underneath it at night. With the toilet facing the aisle, clearing the whole body would require roughly **650–680mm travel**, depending on its stored position.

Longer slides are available in NZ, but their stored length would run through the divider into the storage compartment. **Before selecting those, which way should the toilet face when pulled out: towards the aisle, or towards the front of the van?** Facing forwards looks more promising for keeping the occupied toilet inside the van with the bed extended.

**Facing forwards works better geometrically: 365mm across the van, 415mm front-to-back. I’d plan around 650mm slide travel.**

With the toilet stored near the bench’s aisle edge, that would put its body approximately **27mm clear of the extended bed and 38mm inside the nominal van side**. Those are body clearances; seated shoulder and leg room still need checking.

A suitable heavier slide candidate is **[UES DSCHHD650MML](https://www.ues-hardware.co.nz/drawer-slides/drawer-slides/heavy-duty-lockable/drawer-slides-heavy-duty-650mm-locking-227kg-pair-dschhd650mml)**:

| Specification | Value |
|---|---:|
| Closed length / travel | **650 / 650mm** |
| Height | **75.4mm** |
| Mounting gap per side | **19.5mm** |
| Published pair capacity | **227kg** |
| Pair weight | **6.24kg** |
| Current NZ price | **$116.78 incl. GST**, orderable |

The lighter “125kg” range has conflicting length-dependent ratings: its manufacturer catalogue lists **100kg at 650mm**, below our approximately 115kg loaded estimate. I wouldn’t select that version without resolving the discrepancy. [Manufacturer catalogue](https://www.schutts.com.au/assets/files/EDM%20Pricelist/Final%20catalogue.pdf)

This exposes three changes to the furniture:

- The long rails extend roughly **210mm into the storage half**, requiring passages through the divider.
- A conventional tray with 12mm sides needs approximately **490mm opening width**, exceeding the present 460mm.
- We retain the proposed **340mm opening height**, providing about 20mm clearance above the toilet.

**So the toilet orientation is settled, but these slides carry a substantial weight and storage-space penalty.** I haven’t changed the CAD: the next design step is fitting the tray and rail supports through both bench frames while preserving adequate frame strength and night-time usability.
